Hi Sara — great to hear. Thanks for the windows.

We can run the routing policy workshop and lead the hands-on portion. Draft plan attached (POC_agenda_v2.pdf) — it includes:
- 30m kickoff + goals alignment
- 60–90m hands-on: prompt review, intent routing, model selection, KV/prefix caching basics
- 30m load-run & fallbacks: run a constrained QPS test and trigger fallback conditions
- next steps + metrics to validate (latency, cost per token, success rate)

For the checklist on your side: sample prompts (10–20), expected QPS target (we recommend start at 5–10 rps), and a list of restricted content/PII rules for routing.

I copied Marissa (solutions) who will help with prompt preparation. Can you confirm which of your windows is best? We can do Tue 3/16 10:00 or Wed 3/17 13:00 — if none, we’ll propose alternatives.

Connor O'Brien

Team — forwarding Acme’s note. They want us to lead the routing policy workshop and run a short load test. Can Marissa lead the hands-on prompt review and Diego lead the routing/model selection section? Grace — can you own the load test and KV/cache recommendations (we'll need runtime knobs to cap QPS and a fallback model)?

Quick asks:
- Marissa: can you review the attached agenda and flag any missing steps?
- Diego: bring the model tiering doc (we should recommend an L1 low-latency model + L2 fallback quantized model).
- Grace: what infra do you need from Acme for a light load run? Any special network/VPC notes?

I'll propose Tue 3/16 10:00 and Wed 3/17 13:00 to them. If anyone is unavailable, say so and propose alternates.

Connor
